taxonomy.label: Failed Transaction
taxonomy.description: Payment failures, transaction timeouts, money debited but not credited, UPI errors

taxonomy.label: KYC Friction
taxonomy.description: KYC verification issues, document upload problems, account verification delays

taxonomy.label: Refund Delay
taxonomy.description: Refund not received, cashback not credited, money stuck in processing

taxonomy.label: Customer Support
taxonomy.description: Poor support experience, no response from support, unhelpful agents

taxonomy.label: App Crash / Bug
taxonomy.description: App crashes, freezes, slow loading, technical bugs, login issues

taxonomy.label: UI Confusion
taxonomy.description: Confusing navigation, hard to find features, poor UX design

taxonomy.label: Fraud / Security
taxonomy.description: Unauthorized transactions, phishing, security worries, account hacked

taxonomy.label: Praise / No Issue
taxonomy.description: Positive review, satisfied user, praise for features

taxonomy.label: Other
taxonomy.description: Doesn't fit any other category, or is unintelligible
